body.text: Electric cars use electricity for power. They don't make air pollution. They move with many batteries. Flying cars run in the air. They are a mix of a car and a small airplane. They help you go anywhere quickly. Self-driving cars drive for people. So people can relax. They get information from sensors. They drive safely.
